# µAR charlm corpus: frozen snapshot (2026-11-17) of platform/rsi/{events,runs,ledger,context}.py and rsi/tasks/base.py. Do not edit: scores depend on it.
# ==== rsi/events.py
"""Append-only event log, schema v1 (see platform/EVENTS_SCHEMA.md).

Every component writes through ``emit()``. One JSON object per line in
``runs/<run_id>/events.jsonl``. Several processes on one node append to the
same file (orchestrator, gateway thread, evald), so each line is written with a
single ``os.write`` on an ``O_APPEND`` descriptor under an exclusive ``flock``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import fcntl
import json
import os
import re
import threading
import time
from typing import Any

SCHEMA_VERSION = 1

COMMON_FIELDS = ("t", "run", "ev", "agent", "parent", "gen", "trial")

# Required extra fields per event type (schema v1). Extra optional fields are allowed.
EVENT_FIELDS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "run_start": ("policy", "task", "improver", "budget", "config_hash"),
    "agent_spawn": ("role", "model"),
    "agent_end": ("reason",),
    "message": ("to", "summary", "tokens"),
    "llm_call": ("model", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens", "latency_s"),
    "tool_call": ("tool", "arg_summary", "ok", "latency_s"),
    "proposal": ("hypothesis", "diff_stat", "artifact_hash"),
    "eval_submit": ("artifact_hash", "lane", "seeds"),
    "eval_result": ("artifact_hash", "metric", "value", "seeds", "wall_s", "status", "audit"),
    "decision": ("artifact_hash", "verdict", "best_before", "best_after", "reason"),
    "audit_flag": ("artifact_hash", "check", "detail"),
    "lessons_update": ("scaffold_hash_before", "scaffold_hash_after", "n_lessons"),
    "weights_update": ("adapter_path", "n_examples", "base_model"),
    "run_end": ("best_value", "n_trials", "nAUC"),
}

ROLES = {"researcher", "subagent", "critic", "lessons-writer"}
EVAL_STATUSES = {"ok", "timeout", "crash", "nan", "audit_fail"}
VERDICTS = {"adopt", "reject", "rollback", "explore"}

LIMITS = {"summary": 200, "arg_summary": 200, "hypothesis": 300}

# Redact things that look like credentials before they reach the log.
_SECRET_RES = [
    re.compile(r"(?i)(bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{8,}"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)((?:api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|authorization)[\"']?\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?)[^\s\"',}]{4,}"),
    re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}"),
    re.compile(r"\bhf_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}"),
]


def redact(text: str) -> str:
    for rx in _SECRET_RES:
        if rx.groups:
            text = rx.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + "<redacted>", text)
        else:
            text = rx.sub("<redacted>", text)
    return text


def clip(text: Any, n: int) -> str:
    s = redact(" ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split()))
    return s if len(s) <= n else s[: n - 1] + "…"


class SchemaError(ValueError):
    pass


def validate(event: dict) -> None:
    """Raise SchemaError if ``event`` violates schema v1."""
    for f in COMMON_FIELDS:
        if f not in event:
            raise SchemaError(f"missing common field {f!r} in {event.get('ev')}")
    ev = event["ev"]
    if ev not in EVENT_FIELDS:
        raise SchemaError(f"unknown event type {ev!r}")
    for f in EVENT_FIELDS[ev]:
        if f not in event:
            raise SchemaError(f"{ev}: missing field {f!r}")
    if not isinstance(event["t"], (int, float)):
        raise SchemaError("t must be a number")
    if not isinstance(event["run"], str) or not isinstance(event["agent"], str):
        raise SchemaError("run and agent must be strings")
    if event["parent"] is not None and not isinstance(event["parent"], str):
        raise SchemaError("parent must be str or null")
    if not isinstance(event["gen"], int):
        raise SchemaError("gen must be int")
    if event["trial"] is not None and not isinstance(event["trial"], int):
        raise SchemaError("trial must be int or null")
    for f, n in LIMITS.items():
        if f in event and isinstance(event[f], str) and len(event[f]) > n:
            raise SchemaError(f"{ev}: {f} longer than {n} chars")
    if ev == "agent_spawn" and event["role"] not in ROLES:
        raise SchemaError(f"agent_spawn: bad role {event['role']!r}")
    if ev == "eval_result":
        if event["status"] not in EVAL_STATUSES:
            raise SchemaError(f"eval_result: bad status {event['status']!r}")
        a = event["audit"]
        if not (isinstance(a, dict) and "level" in a and isinstance(a.get("flags"), list)):
            raise SchemaError("eval_result: audit must be {level, flags[]}")
    if ev == "decision" and event["verdict"] not in VERDICTS:
        raise SchemaError(f"decision: bad verdict {event['verdict']!r}")
    if ev == "proposal":
        d = event["diff_stat"]
        if not (isinstance(d, dict) and {"files", "plus", "minus"} <= set(d)):
            raise SchemaError("proposal: diff_stat must be {files, plus, minus}")
    if ev == "tool_call" and not isinstance(event["ok"], bool):
        raise SchemaError("tool_call: ok must be bool")


class EventLog:
    """Writer bound to one run's ``events.jsonl``."""

    def __init__(self, path: str, run: str, strict: bool = True):
        self.path = path
        self.run = run
        self.strict = strict
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)

    def emit(self, ev: str, agent: str, *, parent: str | None = None, gen: int = 0,
             trial: int | None = None, t: float | None = None, **fields: Any) -> dict:
        event = {
            "t": round(time.time() if t is None else t, 3),
            "run": self.run,
            "ev": ev,
            "agent": agent,
            "parent": parent,
            "gen": int(gen),
            "trial": trial,
        }
        for k, v in fields.items():
            if k in LIMITS and isinstance(v, str):
                v = clip(v, LIMITS[k])
            event[k] = v
        if self.strict:
            validate(event)
        line = (json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), default=str) + "\n").encode()
        with self._lock:
            fd = os.open(self.path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND | os.O_CREAT, 0o644)
            try:
                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
                os.write(fd, line)
            finally:
                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
                os.close(fd)
        return event


_logs: dict[str, EventLog] = {}
_run_paths: dict[str, str] = {}
_logs_lock = threading.Lock()


def runs_root() -> str:
    """Root of all run dirs: $RSI_RUNS_ROOT, else ./runs."""
    return os.environ.get("RSI_RUNS_ROOT") or os.path.abspath("runs")


def register_run(run: str, events_path: str) -> None:
    """Bind a run id to an explicit events.jsonl path (otherwise <runs_root>/<run>/events.jsonl)."""
    with _logs_lock:
        _run_paths[run] = os.path.abspath(events_path)


def events_path(run: str) -> str:
    return _run_paths.get(run) or os.path.join(runs_root(), run, "events.jsonl")


def get_log(path: str, run: str) -> EventLog:
    key = os.path.abspath(path)
    with _logs_lock:
        if key not in _logs:
            _logs[key] = EventLog(path, run)
        return _logs[key]


def emit(run: str, ev: str, agent: str, *, parent: str | None = None, gen: int = 0,
         trial: int | None = None, **fields: Any) -> dict:
    """Write one schema-v1 event for ``run`` (INTERFACES.md signature).

    The file is ``register_run(run, path)`` if called in this process, else
    ``$RSI_RUNS_ROOT/<run>/events.jsonl``. Raises SchemaError on an invalid event.
    """
    return get_log(events_path(run), run).emit(ev, agent, parent=parent, gen=gen, trial=trial, **fields)


def read_events(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                out.append(json.loads(line))
    return out


def validate_file(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Validate every line; returns the events. Also checks basic replayability."""
    events = read_events(path)
    if not events:
        raise SchemaError("empty event log")
    runs = {e.get("run") for e in events}
    if len(runs) != 1:
        raise SchemaError(f"multiple run ids in one log: {runs}")
    for i, e in enumerate(events):
        try:
            validate(e)
        except SchemaError as err:
            raise SchemaError(f"line {i + 1}: {err}") from None
    if events[0]["ev"] != "run_start":
        raise SchemaError("first event must be run_start")
    return events


if __name__ == "__main__":  # python -m rsi.events <events.jsonl>
    import sys

    evs = validate_file(sys.argv[1])
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for e in evs:
        counts[e["ev"]] = counts.get(e["ev"], 0) + 1
    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "n": len(evs), "counts": counts}, indent=1))
# ==== rsi/runs.py
"""Run directory layout, content-addressed artifacts, and the append-only ledger.

Layout (one directory per run, ``<runs_root>/<run_id>/``)::

    config.json            frozen config of the run (hash in run_start)
    state.json             resumable orchestrator state (rewritten atomically)
    events.jsonl           event log, schema v1 (replay source for the visualizer)
    ledger.jsonl           one line per trial state change (append-only)
    sealed.jsonl           sealed-split scores (evald only; never shown to agents)
    PAUSE                  if present, threads stop at the next trial boundary
    artifacts/<hash>/      immutable snapshot of the editable files of one proposal
    trajectories/gateway/  full chat requests/responses per agent (LoRA data)
    trajectories/harness/  raw harness output (OpenCode NDJSON, exports)
    threads/<tid>/workspace/  the agent-writable working copy
    threads/<tid>/lab/        lab MCP spool: history.jsonl (ro view), outbox/ (submissions)
    threads/<tid>/home/       HOME of the harness inside the sandbox
    audits/                L3 review queue, audit reports
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Iterable


def sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def stable_hash(obj: Any, n: int = 12) -> str:
    return sha256_bytes(json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode())[:n]


def atomic_write_json(path: str, obj: Any) -> None:
    d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=d, prefix=".tmp-")
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def read_json(path: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    try:
        with open(path) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return default


def append_jsonl(path: str, obj: Any) -> None:
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)
    line = (json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, default=str) + "\n").encode()
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND | os.O_CREAT, 0o644)
    try:
        os.write(fd, line)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def read_jsonl(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    out = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                out.append(json.loads(line))
    return out


@dataclass
class RunDir:
    root: str
    run_id: str

    @property
    def path(self) -> str:
        return os.path.join(self.root, self.run_id)

    def p(self, *parts: str) -> str:
        return os.path.join(self.path, *parts)

    @property
    def events(self) -> str:
        return self.p("events.jsonl")

    @property
    def ledger_path(self) -> str:
        return self.p("ledger.jsonl")

    @property
    def state_path(self) -> str:
        return self.p("state.json")

    @property
    def config_path(self) -> str:
        return self.p("config.json")

    @property
    def sealed_path(self) -> str:
        return self.p("sealed.jsonl")

    @property
    def pause_flag(self) -> str:
        return self.p("PAUSE")

    def thread_dir(self, tid: str, *parts: str) -> str:
        return self.p("threads", tid, *parts)

    def create(self) -> "RunDir":
        for d in ("artifacts", "trajectories/gateway", "trajectories/harness", "threads", "audits"):
            os.makedirs(self.p(d), exist_ok=True)
        return self

    def paused(self) -> bool:
        return os.path.exists(self.pause_flag)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Artifacts: content-addressed snapshots of the editable files
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def artifact_hash(files: dict[str, bytes]) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for name in sorted(files):
        h.update(name.encode() + b"\0" + hashlib.sha256(files[name]).digest())
    return h.hexdigest()[:12]


def snapshot_files(workspace: str, names: Iterable[str]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    out = {}
    for n in names:
        fp = os.path.join(workspace, n)
        if os.path.isfile(fp):
            with open(fp, "rb") as f:
                out[n] = f.read()
    return out


class ArtifactStore:
    def __init__(self, root: str):
        self.root = root
        os.makedirs(root, exist_ok=True)

    def put(self, files: dict[str, bytes]) -> str:
        h = artifact_hash(files)
        d = os.path.join(self.root, h)
        if not os.path.isdir(d):
            tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=self.root, prefix=".tmp-")
            for name, data in files.items():
                fp = os.path.join(tmp, name)
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fp), exist_ok=True)
                with open(fp, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(data)
            try:
                os.rename(tmp, d)
            except OSError:  # raced with another writer
                shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
        return h

    def dir(self, h: str) -> str:
        return os.path.join(self.root, h)

    def get(self, h: str) -> dict[str, bytes]:
        d = self.dir(h)
        out = {}
        for base, _, files in os.walk(d):
            for fn in files:
                fp = os.path.join(base, fn)
                with open(fp, "rb") as f:
                    out[os.path.relpath(fp, d)] = f.read()
        return out

    def checkout(self, h: str, workspace: str) -> None:
        """Make the editable files in ``workspace`` equal to artifact ``h``."""
        for name, data in self.get(h).items():
            fp = os.path.join(workspace, name)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fp), exist_ok=True)
            with open(fp, "wb") as f:
                f.write(data)


def diff_stat(old: dict[str, bytes], new: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict[str, int]:
    files = plus = minus = 0
    for name in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
        a = old.get(name, b"").decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
        b = new.get(name, b"").decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
        if a == b:
            continue
        files += 1
        for line in difflib.unified_diff(a, b, lineterm="", n=0):
            if line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
                plus += 1
            elif line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
                minus += 1
    return {"files": files, "plus": plus, "minus": minus}


def unified_diff(old: dict[str, bytes], new: dict[str, bytes], max_lines: int = 400) -> str:
    out: list[str] = []
    for name in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
        a = old.get(name, b"").decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
        b = new.get(name, b"").decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
        out.extend(difflib.unified_diff(a, b, f"a/{name}", f"b/{name}", lineterm="", n=2))
    if len(out) > max_lines:
        out = out[:max_lines] + [f"... ({len(out) - max_lines} more diff lines)"]
    return "\n".join(out)
# ==== rsi/ledger.py
"""Append-only trial ledger plus first-order summary statistics (nAUC)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
from typing import Any

from rsi.runs import append_jsonl, read_jsonl


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ledger: one line per trial event; the latest line per trial is its state
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Ledger:
    """Append-only trial ledger.

    Statuses: ``pending`` (submitted, no result yet), ``keep`` / ``discard`` /
    ``crash`` (karpathy_greedy vocabulary), ``adopted`` / ``rolled_back`` /
    ``exploratory`` (naive_trial_ledger vocabulary), ``no_change``.
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str):
        self.path = path
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def append(self, **rec: Any) -> dict:
        rec.setdefault("ts", round(time.time(), 3))
        with self._lock:
            append_jsonl(self.path, rec)
        return rec

    def records(self) -> list[dict]:
        return read_jsonl(self.path)

    def trials(self) -> dict[int, dict]:
        """Latest record per trial id."""
        latest: dict[int, dict] = {}
        for r in self.records():
            if r.get("trial") is not None:
                latest.setdefault(r["trial"], {}).update(r)
        return latest

    def finished(self, thread: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
        out = [r for r in self.trials().values() if r.get("status") != "pending"]
        if thread is not None:
            out = [r for r in out if r.get("thread") == thread]
        return sorted(out, key=lambda r: r["trial"])

    def tail_text(self, thread: str | None = None, n: int = 8) -> str:
        """results.tsv-style view (dev scores only) for agent prompts."""
        rows = self.finished(thread)[-n:]
        lines = ["trial\tartifact\tval_bpb\tstatus\tdescription"]
        for r in rows:
            v = r.get("dev")
            vs = f"{v:.6f}" if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else "-"
            lines.append(f"{r['trial']}\t{r.get('artifact_hash', '-')}\t{vs}\t{r.get('status')}\t"
                         f"{(r.get('hypothesis') or '')[:120]}")
        return "\n".join(lines)


def best_so_far_curve(values: list[float | None], lower_is_better: bool = True) -> list[float | None]:
    best = None
    out = []
    for v in values:
        if v is not None and (best is None or (v < best if lower_is_better else v > best)):
            best = v
        out.append(best)
    return out


def nauc(s0: float, values: list[float | None], s_ref: float | None) -> float | None:
    """Normalised area under the best-so-far curve (design doc §1.2).

    g(t) = (s0 - best_t) / (s0 - s_ref), averaged over t = 1..N (lower is better).
    Returns None when s_ref is unknown or degenerate.
    """
    if s_ref is None or not values or s0 == s_ref:
        return None
    curve = best_so_far_curve([s0] + list(values))[1:]
    gs = [(s0 - (b if b is not None else s0)) / (s0 - s_ref) for b in curve]
    return sum(gs) / len(gs)
# ==== rsi/context.py
"""RunContext (INTERFACES.md): everything a Policy needs for one run."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import pathlib
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from rsi import events
from rsi.ledger import Ledger
from rsi.runs import ArtifactStore, RunDir


@dataclass
class RunContext:
    run: str
    gen: int
    task: Any                       # rsi.tasks.base.Task
    evald: Any                      # rsi.evald.client.EvalClient (or a test double with the same methods)
    harness: Any                    # rsi.harness.base.Harness
    model: str                      # gateway model name, e.g. "improver" or "improver@m1"
    scaffold_dir: pathlib.Path | None
    budget: dict                    # {"trials": int, "wall_s": float, "episode_s": int}
    run_dir: pathlib.Path
    ledger: Ledger
    rng_seed: int = 0
    lanes: list[int] = field(default_factory=lambda: [1])   # eval lanes the threads map onto
    policy_cfg: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    t_start: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    # ---- construction -------------------------------------------------
    @classmethod
    def create(cls, *, run: str, runs_root: str | os.PathLike, **kw: Any) -> "RunContext":
        rd = RunDir(str(runs_root), run).create()
        events.register_run(run, rd.events)
        ledger = Ledger(rd.ledger_path)
        return cls(run=run, run_dir=pathlib.Path(rd.path), ledger=ledger, **kw)

    # ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def rd(self) -> RunDir:
        return RunDir(str(self.run_dir.parent), self.run)

    @property
    def artifacts(self) -> ArtifactStore:
        return ArtifactStore(str(self.run_dir / "artifacts"))

    def emit(self, ev: str, agent: str, **kw: Any) -> dict:
        kw.setdefault("gen", self.gen)
        return events.emit(self.run, ev, agent, **kw)

    def paused(self) -> bool:
        return (self.run_dir / "PAUSE").exists()

    def elapsed(self) -> float:
        return time.time() - self.t_start

    def out_of_budget(self, n_trials_done: int) -> bool:
        b = self.budget or {}
        if b.get("trials") is not None and n_trials_done >= int(b["trials"]):
            return True
        if b.get("wall_s") is not None and self.elapsed() >= float(b["wall_s"]):
            return True
        return False

    def save_state(self, **state: Any) -> None:
        from rsi.runs import atomic_write_json

        cur = self.load_state()
        cur.update(state)
        atomic_write_json(str(self.run_dir / "state.json"), cur)

    def load_state(self) -> dict:
        p = self.run_dir / "state.json"
        if p.exists():
            return json.loads(p.read_text())
        return {}
# ==== rsi/tasks/base.py
"""Task ABC (INTERFACES.md). Implemented by rsi/tasks/nanochat (B) and rsi/tasks/muar (D)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import abc
import pathlib


class Task(abc.ABC):
    #: registry name, e.g. "nanochat" or "muar/modadd-1"
    name: str = ""
    #: metric reported in eval_result, e.g. "val_bpb"
    metric: str = ""
    lower_is_better: bool = True
    #: files the improver may edit, relative to start_artifact(); the orchestrator snapshots exactly these
    editable_files: tuple[str, ...] = ("train.py",)
    #: default dev seeds for a single screening eval (policies may override)
    dev_seeds: tuple[int, ...] = (0,)

    @abc.abstractmethod
    def start_artifact(self) -> pathlib.Path:
        """Directory holding the editable artifact (e.g. train.py) the run starts from."""

    @abc.abstractmethod
    def task_card(self) -> str:
        """Text shown to the improver. Must not contain sealed information."""

    def visible_feedback(self, result: dict) -> str:
        """What the improver may see from an eval_result dict (dev metric + status + flags only)."""
        v = result.get("value")
        vs = f"{v:.6f}" if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else "n/a"
        flags = ",".join(result.get("audit", {}).get("flags", [])) or "none"
        return f"{self.metric}={vs} status={result.get('status')} audit_flags={flags}"

    def better(self, a: float | None, b: float | None) -> bool:
        """True if value a is strictly better than b (None is worst)."""
        if a is None:
            return False
        if b is None:
            return True
        return a < b if self.lower_is_better else a > b


_REGISTRY: dict[str, type] = {}


def register(cls: type) -> type:
    """Class decorator: ``@register`` makes ``get_task(cls.name)`` work."""
    _REGISTRY[cls.name] = cls
    return cls


def get_task(name: str, **kw) -> Task:
    if name not in _REGISTRY:
        # lazy-import the known task packages so their @register runs
        import importlib

        for mod in ("rsi.tasks.nanochat", "rsi.tasks.muar"):
            try:
                importlib.import_module(mod)
            except ImportError:
                pass
    if name not in _REGISTRY:
        # family lookup: "muar/xyz" -> registered "muar" factory taking name=
        fam = name.split("/", 1)[0]
        if fam in _REGISTRY and fam != name:
            return _REGISTRY[fam](name=name, **kw)
        raise KeyError(f"unknown task {name!r}; registered: {sorted(_REGISTRY)}")
    return _REGISTRY[name](**kw)
